slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A genuine concern is that a new repayment will simply become another bill to juggle. Well-structured finance is sized and timed against your actual cash flow, repayments matched to what the business can realistically sustain, rather than added on top without regard for existing pressure.

caption:
It's a fair worry, the last thing a cash-strained business needs is another repayment obligation layered on top. Which is exactly why serviceability assessment exists: to check that a proposed facility is genuinely sustainable against your actual cash flow, not just approved because the numbers technically allow it.

Being upfront about current pressure, rather than glossing over it, leads to a structure that's more likely to actually help.
